'''August 2001 Hutton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hutton, Essex, UK on 26 August 2001. [[Neil Goodacre]] won it. It is known from Neil Goodacre's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2897">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01d2897/ hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01], DeckTech (Phat "Phat2" Two, 27 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01d2897/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Hutton, Essex, UK
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Neil Goodacre]]
